subject.title: Gemini models output inline buttons as raw JSON text instead of using tool format

question: Should OpenClaw support raw `[[...]]` inline-button JSON in model final text as a constrained Gemini fallback, or require provider/prompt repair so models emit typed message-tool presentation buttons only?
rationale: Current source proves the reported gap, but the likely fix creates a model-output fallback syntax crossing prompt, final-reply sanitization, transcript, and Telegram rendering boundaries.

options.title: Accept Narrow Raw Fallback
options.body: Allow a constrained parser only after the linked PR or a replacement is rebased, transcript-safe, and backed by redacted live Gemini/Telegram proof.

options.title: Require Typed Presentation
options.body: Reject raw final-text parsing and focus the issue on provider or prompt routing so Gemini emits `message(action=send)` with structured buttons.

options.title: Wait For Live Repro
options.body: Keep the issue open but pause implementation until a reporter or maintainer supplies a reproducible Gemini/Telegram trace.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Raw Fallback
recommendation.body: Allow a constrained parser only after the linked PR or a replacement is rebased, transcript-safe, and backed by redacted live Gemini/Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision affects the typed presentation contract and Telegram button rendering paths where the current history points most strongly to Peter Steinberger.
